lines.speaker: Junia
lines.text: You always look like the weight of the feast is yours alone.

lines.speaker: Junia
lines.text: That is not what Hadarah said. That is what fear says when it refuses to be loved.

lines.speaker: Elior
lines.text: I do not know how to rest when people are hurting.

lines.speaker: Junia
lines.text: I am not good at sitting still either. I rush because I am afraid love will slip away if I do not hold it.

lines.speaker: Junia
lines.text: But I am learning that love does not clutch. It receives. It gives. It stays.

lines.speaker: Elior
lines.text: You make it sound almost possible.

lines.speaker: Junia
lines.text: I did not say easy. I said received.
